existing_results.hypotheses: IsOpen J; U : Set (Sphere2 × J) open and IsPreconnected; FiberSaturated (frontier U) in the relative product. Compact nonempty-frontier clause is an implication. Unique endgame node with a \lean tag.

Embedding f : Sphere2 × Icc a b → Y; D open; ∃ T, f ⁻¹' frontier D = univ ×ˢ T; a point of the open collar lies in D. Gives full-fiber cylinders over open OrdConnected A ⊆ (a,b) and a three-way alternative on every closed-collar fiber. Does not identify an endpoint fiber as a connected component of the ambient frontier.

J open OrdConnected; U : Set (Sphere2 × J) open, connected, FiberSaturated (frontier U), compact closure. Conclusion topological: closure U ≃ₜ Sphere2 × Icc 0 1 and the two endpoint fibers are the frontier components. No diffeomorphism, no bundle branch.
Same product topology plus ChartedSpace/IsManifold on closure D and IsSmoothEmbedding of Subtype.val : closure D → Sphere2 × J. Does not construct that atlas.

Sphere2 FiberBundle over AddCircle L, L>0, locally smooth charts; D open connected; ChartedSpace/IsManifold on closure D; IsSmoothEmbedding of the inclusion; matching ranks; inclusion image of I.boundary = frontier D; ProjectionSaturated nonempty frontier. Closure already a manifold with boundary in the hypotheses.
φ : Sphere2 ≃ₜ Sphere2; L>0; D open connected regular-open in MappingTorus.Space φ.symm L; FiberSaturated (proj ⁻¹' frontier D); nonempty frontier. Homeomorphism only.

Y Hausdorff locally connected; C closed; finite open embeddings f i : Sphere2 × NeckParameter → Y with f i z ∈ C ↔ (z.2 : ℝ) ≤ 0; frontier C = union of central sections; pairwise disjoint; p ∉ C; complementary component proper. Collars are inputs. No 1-vs-2 count.
p ∉ C and connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p ≠ connectedComponent p. No collar or surgery.
